title: Puppet masters in Plato's Cave omitted from teaching

tellings.quote: in her latest book called encounters Diana writes that she refrained from teaching her students one thing about Plato's Cave allegory the existence of the Puppet Masters

plain: A religious studies professor named Diana Pasulka chose not to teach her students one part of Plato's allegory of the cave: the puppet masters who cast the shadows the prisoners take for reality. Michels says this in 2023, telling it from her book Encounters, where he says she writes about holding it back. He raises it because it suggests that someone may be shaping what people see, an idea he ties to UFOs and religion.
